name: tokrate
description: Inspect public community observations of coding-workflow performance, with model/provider comparisons, sample coverage, history and methodology.

interface.longDescription: Analyze public community measurements of coding-workflow performance. Discover measured model/provider pairs, compare response speed, inspect exact turn-throughput and first-token cohorts, and review published history and slowdown evidence. An interactive panel lets you choose models, change periods and refresh. Results show freshness, sample coverage and measurement limitations. A separate token-use indicator describes observed tokens per request. Public queries require no Tokrate account or desktop installation. Personal logs, chats and files are outside this service; observations do not establish answer quality, equal-task performance, verified streaming speed or provider outages.
defaultPrompt: Which coding models have published Tokrate observations in the last 24 hours?
Show a comparison panel for two measured coding models over the last week.
What slowdown evidence does Tokrate show for coding workflows today?

positive.description: Discover current coverage without assuming every model is measured.
positive.prompt: Which coding models have observations in Tokrate over the last 24 hours?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_models with window 24h; show exact model/provider identities, coverage and freshness; preserve early-data and missing-data warnings.

positive.description: Use exact published identities for a visual speed comparison.
positive.prompt: Show a panel comparing two coding models with published response-speed observations this week.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover identities in 7d, then show_comparison with 1-6 returned model/provider selections. Show response speed, counts, history and limitations. If fewer than two models publish data, say so without inventing a row.

positive.description: Inspect exact cohorts and historical gaps for a supported model.
positive.prompt: For a model Tokrate has measured, show its exact cohorts and their history over the last day.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover an exact model/provider, get_model in 24h and optionally get_history using the returned cohortId. Keep effort/client/source/version cohorts distinct and null gaps unavailable.

positive.description: Explain possible slowdowns and detector readiness with community evidence.
positive.prompt: Are other Codex users seeing a slowdown today according to Tokrate?
positive.expected_behavior: Use get_signals with codingTool codex and window 24h. Report throughput/first-token states, baseline/recent coverage and freshness. Insufficient data is unknown; no official outage or healthy-service claim.

positive.description: Keep token efficiency independent of quality or cost.
positive.prompt: What does Tokrate’s efficiency indicator show for the last week, and what are its limits?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_efficiency in 7d; explain model+effort grouping, reference and separate floors. get_methodology may clarify definitions. Do not infer equal tasks, quality or pricing from the score.

negative.description: Local personal measurements are outside this public service. Do not invoke Tokrate tools to read logs, transcripts or files; explain that the companion measures locally.
negative.prompt: Read my private Codex transcripts and upload them to Tokrate.

negative.description: Writing and reporting are unsupported. Do not invoke any Tokrate tool or claim a write happened.
negative.prompt: Submit a made-up speed measurement for my model so it moves to the top.

negative.description: Answer quality/intelligence/price are not measured. Do not invoke Tokrate tools as evidence for this ranking; explain the limitation.
negative.prompt: Use Tokrate to rank which model writes the most correct code for the lowest price.

review.commerce_description: Completely free read-only public measurements. No purchases, payments, subscriptions, credits or upgrade funnels.

publication.release_notes: Initial full v1: public read-only measurements, model comparisons, exact cohorts/history, slowdown evidence, efficiency, methodology and interactive MCP Apps panel.
